== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Reavers]] are biological abominations created by the [[Iron Legion]]. These creatures are characterized by a fusion of organic matter and metal, featuring living [[steel]] that has been melted or welded directly into their flesh. While they retain much of their original human-like structure, they are physically enhanced beyond normal limits to become highly dangerous combatants. Their physical forms vary, but common configurations include limbs that have grown into crude blades or integrated gun barrels. Some specimens possess mechanical eyes that can emit red light, and they are known for their durability in combat, often requiring more than a single shot to be defeated.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|These humanoid figures are abominations composed of a mixture of organic structure and living [[steel]] armor. Their physical forms consist of reanimated flesh integrated with various cyborg pieces.}}
